hooks.prompt: Plan was just approved by the user. Default action: delegate execution to the zensu:tdd-manager subagent — pass the approved plan content as the feature specification. Skip tdd-manager ONLY if the plan is doc-only, a trivial config tweak, or otherwise not code that benefits from RED/GREEN TDD; in that case proceed normally and briefly state why TDD is being skipped. If the user's approval message explicitly requests a different approach (e.g. 'approve, no tdd'), respect that.
The TDD manager has finished implementation. Run /reflect now to review this session's changes in your current context before proceeding with any further steps.
The code reviewer has finished. Present the review report to the user and ask if any findings should be addressed.

hooks.command: bash -c 'HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null) || { echo "zensu: not a git repository, pulse session skipped"; exit 0; }; BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$BRANCH" ] && BRANCH="detached"; echo "zensu: pulse session ready — HEAD=$HEAD branch=$BRANCH"'
